title: transfer_moves_exact_amount
description: A successful transfer(to, v) decreases the caller's balance by v and increases to's balance by v (no change when to == caller), leaves every other balance and totalSupply unchanged, and returns true.

title: transfer_revert_conditions
description: transfer(to, v) (with no ETH sent) reverts if and only if to is the zero address, to is SavingsDai, or the caller's balance is below v.

title: transferFrom_moves_exact_amount_and_spends_allowance
description: A successful transferFrom(from, to, v) moves exactly v from from to to, leaves totalSupply unchanged, and if the caller is not from and the allowance is finite, decreases allowance[from][caller] by exactly v; an infinite allowance or a self-spend leaves the allowance unchanged.

title: transferFrom_revert_conditions
description: transferFrom(from, to, v) (no ETH) reverts if and only if to is zero or SavingsDai, from's balance is below v, or the caller is not from and has a finite allowance below v.

title: approve_and_allowance_adjustments_are_exact
description: approve sets allowance[caller][spender] to exactly the value; increaseAllowance adds exactly the value (reverting on overflow); decreaseAllowance subtracts exactly the value and reverts iff it exceeds the current allowance. None of them change any balance or other allowance.

title: balance_decrease_requires_owner_or_allowance
description: For any SavingsDai method, if an account's share balance decreases by d and the caller is not that account, the caller held an allowance of at least d from that account beforehand.

title: allowance_changes_only_by_authorized_actions
description: allowance[owner][spender] can increase only through a call by owner (approve/increaseAllowance) or a permit for owner; it can decrease only when the caller is owner or spender, or via permit.

title: third_party_balances_unaffected
description: No SavingsDai method changes the share balance of an account that is neither the caller nor an address argument of the call (from/to/receiver/owner).

title: total_supply_changes_only_via_vault_operations
description: totalSupply increases only through deposit/mint and decreases only through withdraw/redeem; ERC20 and permit methods never change it.
